basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/NetcraftIntegrationGateway/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Netcraft is a global leader in cybercrime detection and takedown, protecting the world's biggest brands and their customers from phishing, scams and online fraud. This solution brings that intelligence directly into Microsoft Sentinel. Takedown activity, domain detection results, Social (Fraud Detection) findings across social media, advertising platforms and mobile app stores, and deep and dark web matches all flow into dedicated tables, where pre-built analytics rules turn them into incidents in your existing queue. Workbooks give operational dashboards per product area, and hunting queries support proactive investigation. Your SOC can triage external threats in the same place as everything else, without leaving the Defender portal. Connection takes a single API key. No Azure Functions, no additional infrastructure. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 14, **Workbooks:** 6, **Analytic Rules:** 16, **Hunting Queries:** 6 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Netcraft Integration Gateway. You can get Netcraft Integration Gateway data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

link.label: Learn more about connecting data sources

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway Takedown records, notes, and tag changes with attack_type / domain_attack / hostname_attack latest-state rollups and TakedownId/GroupId drill-down.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway Domain Detection results with risk, tags, and latest-state rollups.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches with priority, type, and latest-state rollups.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway Social results with platform, social type, risk, pending client input, and latest-state rollups.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway App results with platform, risk, pending client input, and latest-state rollups.
Aggregate view of Integration Gateway Advert results with platform, risk, pending client input, and latest-state rollups.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

Identifies new Netcraft Takedown records from the Integration Gateway (`EventType == "takedown"` and `ChangeType == "new"`).
Updates to an existing takedown do not alert; use the Takedown workbook to follow status changes. `IsAuthorized` and `IsEscalated` are booleans.

Identifies Netcraft Takedown records where action is waiting on the customer
(`EventType == "takedown"` and `ActionRequired` is not `no`).
Identifies important notes added, updated, or deleted on Netcraft takedowns or takedown groups.

Identifies Netcraft Takedown records whose status is `resolved`
(`EventType == "takedown"`). The gateway status enum is lowercase.
Raises an alert only; no incident is created.

elements.name: analytic5
elements.label: Netcraft Domain Detection - High risk result

options.text:
Identifies newly reported Domain Detection results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so updates for the same DomainResultId do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.

elements.name: analytic6
elements.label: Netcraft Domain Detection - Newly registered high risk

options.text:
Identifies Domain Detection results whose tag `display_name` is `Newly Registered (24h)` with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so the same DomainResultId alerts once per window.

Identifies Domain Detection results whose tag `display_name` is `Preemptive Disruption`.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so the same DomainResultId alerts once per window.

elements.name: analytic8
elements.label: Netcraft DDW Intelligence - High priority match

options.text:
Identifies Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches with Priority of high.
Uses NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest so the same MatchUuid alerts once per window.

elements.name: analytic9
elements.label: Netcraft DDW Intelligence - Takedown eligible match

options.text:
Identifies Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches that are takedown eligible.
Uses NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest so the same MatchUuid alerts once per window.

elements.name: analytic10
elements.label: Netcraft DDW Intelligence - Unacknowledged high priority

options.text:
Identifies high-priority Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches that are still unacknowledged (`Acknowledged == false`).
Uses NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest so the same MatchUuid alerts once per window.

Identifies newly reported Social results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftSocialResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.

Identifies newly reported App results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftAppResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.

Identifies newly reported Advert results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.

Identifies Social results that are waiting for client input.
A result needs client input when any tag on the result (`data.tags`) has category `input_required`.
Uses NetcraftSocialResult_Latest so one ResultUuid alerts from the latest social result in the window.

Identifies App results that are waiting for client input.
A result needs client input when any tag on the result (`data.tags`) has category `input_required`.
Uses NetcraftAppResult_Latest so one ResultUuid alerts from the latest app result in the window.

Identifies Advert results that are waiting for client input.
A result needs client input when any tag on the result (`data.tags`) has category `input_required`.
Uses NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest so one ResultUuid alerts from the latest advert result in the window.
This solution installs the following hunting queries. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats in Manage solution view.

Latest takedown record state per `subject` for the last 7 days via
`NetcraftTakedown_Latest` (`EventType == "takedown"` rolled up by Subject). This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftTakedown_CL Parser or Table)

7-day inventory of latest Domain Detection results with risk, tag display_name flags, and infrastructure fields.
Collapses deliveries to one row per DomainResultId via NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest. This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftDomainDetection_CL Parser or Table)

7-day inventory of latest Deep & Dark Web intelligence matches (`match.discovered`) with priority, type, and source fields.
Collapses deliveries to one row per MatchUuid via NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest. This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftDdwIntelligence_CL Parser or Table)

7-day inventory of latest Social results with platform, social type, and risk.
Collapses deliveries to one row per ResultUuid via NetcraftSocialResult_Latest. This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftSocialResult_CL Parser or Table)

7-day inventory of latest App results with platform, developer, and risk.
Collapses deliveries to one row per ResultUuid via NetcraftAppResult_Latest. This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftAppResult_CL Parser or Table)

7-day inventory of latest Advert results with advertiser, title, and risk.
Collapses deliveries to one row per ResultUuid via NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest.
Payload title is stored as AdvertTitle. This hunting query depends on NetcraftIntegrationGatewayDefinition data connector (NetcraftAdvertResult_CL Parser or Table)
